quotes.text: The Hebrew priests, when they appeared before the Lord, performed the service with naked feet, a symbol of veneration. See Exodus 3: 5. — Josh. 5: 15. Now a days the world’s priests wear boots or shoes well blacked as an act of decorum and not see God.
